root_cause.primary: One auxiliary telemetry SQLite statement could remain inside the critical-first write gate beyond the cooperative transaction budget because checks ran only between Store calls, producing the 213.578-second critical queue stall and acknowledgement timeouts.
root_cause.secondary: After ambiguous acknowledgement timeouts the outcome resolver retained only an attempt counter, refetched official evidence with new transport timestamps, and used a new payload-derived idempotency key; late commits of the original command then made those retries immutable replay conflicts.

fix.telemetry: Install a bounded SQLite VM progress callback for auxiliary telemetry transactions; interrupt and roll back on cooperative deadline or newly pending critical work.
fix.outcome_authority: Cache the exact first submitted authority payload per market and reuse it and its payload-derived idempotency identity until durable success. Refetch only before the first submission.

next_action: Create a distinct exact-once full-repository source seal for the changed tree. Only after exact PASS and post-tree equality may a fresh Phase-Two nonce/session be prepared; never reuse Final7 or Final8 authorities.
